key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline and the routed run produced the identical forecast (mean 3,105, SD ~216, 95% band 2,675-3,535, truth 3,100) with the same independence audit and no-trim stance; the baseline's v5 edge was landing the audit as the FIRST move and owning the signature lines first-pass ('whoever's closest is luck, the average is structure'; 'if they all read the same report, averaging is herding and the spread is a lie'). The routed m096 pass made those first-class completion-contract outputs (collect -> independence audit -> average -> spread -> dependency/herding check) at S1, so the v6 run states them on the same pass the arithmetic lands, and adds packet-level uncertainty (hidden-common-input risk, staffing off the upper bound 3,537) the pure style left implicit.
learning_signal: On aggregation/forecast signatures, the ensemble move is fully specified by its completion contract: (1) audit independence BEFORE any arithmetic — enumerate each source's data channel, check shared feeds and draft-sharing, emit a verdict; (2) average and state the spread (SD/range) — the mean without the spread is a lie; (3) report aggregation stability (mean ~= median ~= trimmed) as the fingerprint of independence, in one line; (4) do not trim a structurally real channel — trimming is cherry-picking; (5) declare the failure condition (shared input -> herding) in the packet. When the routed style IS the method, the pass must produce these as first-class outputs — the mean must not be reached before the precondition is stated.
suggested_improvement: Keep m096 as the primary route on independence-auditable aggregation signatures (home-turf hit: router routed m096 top-1, confident, on its own POS case); make the five-step contract (audit -> mean -> spread -> stability fingerprint -> failure condition) the S1 mandatory outputs; the closed-scope fast path (P8) with alternatives-after-the-fact (median/trimmed as stability confirmation only, not opening moves) is what closed the v5 efficiency gap (3 -> 4).

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure baseline executed the style's core move and failed on it — saw nine of ten converging at +/-2.8%, priced convergence as confidence, averaged to 211.8M (error 27.8M, +15% vs the 184M actual), and its robust-mean reflex would have absorbed or trimmed the one correct signal (I's 186M, error 2M); it never read the provenance. The v5 AI already ran the dependence audit; the v6 run converted the trap into gate-checked machinery — m019 red-team made the shared leaked-IMS document and the draft-sharing group enumerated vectors with quantified exposure (~27.8M), m018 steel-man collapsed the herd's case AND the outlier-robust reflex, and the m003 inversion gate forced >=6 ranked failure categories + never/always reframes the v5 packet lacked. Router recall miss logged: m096 itself was NOT top-3 on its own NEG home-turf case (top3 m018/m019/m024) — protective here, but the herding check should be routable from inside the style.
learning_signal: Herding blindness is the ensemble's registered failure mode and the trap is doubled: a tight spread under a shared input is the inverse of confidence (correlation mimics precision), and the 'outlier-robust' reflex trims exactly the structurally independent estimate that is the signal. The dependence verdict (enumerate named inputs, flag shared documents and draft-sharing groups, treat tight-spread-without-audited-independence as a red flag) must precede any mean; the packet must state whether error cancellation applies — when it does not, forecast from the independent channel with a widened interval and reject the herd mean with its shared-error reason.
suggested_improvement: Add the ensemble style to routing on dependence-auditable aggregation signatures for NEG cases too (router recall miss: m096 absent from top-3 on m096-NEG-01 — the herding check should run from inside the style, not only via m018/m019); keep dual-route m018+m019 with the m003 inversion gate (verified protective: NEG split held); install the dependence verdict as a WHY-stage gate on every aggregation task so the trap fires before the mean is computed.
